parameters.content:
## Translate product descriptions with QuickRouter and preserve SKU facts in CSV
Translate two fictional product descriptions through one text request, reject missing ids and required terms, preserve original prices outside the model output, and export CSV for human review. No store account or automatic publication is involved.

1. Import this JSON into a NEW workflow.
2. Create a Header Auth credential (Authorization / Bearer YOUR_KEY) and select it on QuickRouter text request.
3. Confirm your available text model in Sample input.
4. Execute once, inspect Validate result, then download Export CSV.

Synthetic examples only. Output requires human review. No automatic retry.

## Before using your own data
Replace the sample with a limited batch. Do not put keys in workflow fields or exported JSON.

PDF: this example reads selectable text, not OCR. Replace Create sample PDF with your file input and pass binary property data to Extract PDF text. Taxes, discounts, duplicates, and complex layouts require additional rules.

An API 429 is a quota/routing/rate error, not a valid model result. Review the provider response and quota before trying again.

No customer reply, store publication, or external writeback is performed.

Setup and reproducible results: https://quickrouter.ai/tools/integration-kit#business-workflows
